title: css
content:
# CSS, SCSS and Less {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode %} has built-in support for editing style sheets in CSS `.css`, SCSS `.scss` and Less `.less`. In addition, you can install an extension for greater functionality.
> **Tip:** Click on an extension tile above to read the description and reviews to decide which extension is best for you. See more in the [Marketplace](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com).
